summary: Ainos, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026 reporting that its board unanimously approved second amended and restated bylaws effective October 14, 2026, adopting a classified board. Directors are split into three classes: Class I (Ting-Chuan Lee, Chun-Jung Tsai, Chung-Yi Tsai) expiring at the 2026 annual meeting; Class II (Yao-Chung Chiang, Pao-Sheng Wei) at 2027; Class III (Chun-Hsien Tsai, Wen-Han Chang) at 2028, with three-year terms thereafter. The board also amended corporate governance policies to reflect the structure. No advisor, price, or stake terms were disclosed. The staggered board entrenches incumbents and raises the cost of any hostile or activist effort; watch for shareholder opposition or bylaw challenges ahead of the 2026 meeting.
